'''2012 Match Play Championship Day 2 Greg Shaw LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2012 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Communing (Virtual Block 7)|Communing]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
